motifs.name: stm_minority_pawn_majority_lever
motifs.description: The side to move has more pawns than the opponent on either the same-file center pair (d+e files) or on both wings combined (a-c plus f-h files), with total pawn count at least equal, indicating a lever-ready structural edge.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'stm_minority_pawn_majority_lever'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has more pawns than the opponent on either the same-file center pair (d+e files) or on both wings combined (a-c plus f-h files), with total pawn count at least equal, indicating a lever-ready structural edge.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    b = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = b.turn
    opp = not b.turn
    def pawns_on_files(color, files):
        n = 0
        for f in files:
            n += len([sq for sq in b.pieces(chess.PAWN, color) if chess.square_file(sq) == f])
        return n
    stm_total = len(b.pieces(chess.PAWN, stm))
    opp_total = len(b.pieces(chess.PAWN, opp))
    if stm_total < opp_total:
        return False
    center_stm = pawns_on_files(stm, [3, 4])
    center_opp = pawns_on_files(opp, [3, 4])
    if center_stm > center_opp and center_opp <= 2:
        return True
    wing_stm = pawns_on_files(stm, [0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7])
    wing_opp = pawns_on_files(opp, [0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7])
    if wing_stm > wing_opp and stm_total > opp_total:
        return True
    return False

motifs.name: stm_material_advantage_two_or_more
motifs.description: The side to move has at least two points more total piece value (pawn=1, knight/bishop=3, rook=5, queen=9) than the opponent.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'stm_material_advantage_two_or_more'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has at least two points more total piece value (pawn=1, knight/bishop=3, rook=5, queen=9) than the opponent.'
import chess

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    vals = {
        chess.PAWN: 1,
        chess.KNIGHT: 3,
        chess.BISHOP: 3,
        chess.ROOK: 5,
        chess.QUEEN: 9,
    }
    s = 0
    o = 0
    for sq in chess.SQUARES:
        p = board.piece_at(sq)
        if p is None or p.piece_type == chess.KING:
            continue
        v = vals[p.piece_type]
        if p.color == stm:
            s += v
        else:
            o += v
    return s - o >= 2

motifs.name: stm_pawn_island_advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has fewer pawn-island groups (maximal sets of pawns on contiguous files) than the opponent, indicating a more cohesive pawn structure.

motifs.name: stm_mobility_advantage_over_opp
motifs.description: The side to move has at least five more legal moves than the opponent.
motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'stm_mobility_advantage_over_opp'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has at least five more legal moves than the opponent.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    b = chess.Board(fen)
    b2 = b.copy()
    b2.turn = not b.turn
    return b.legal_moves.count() - b2.legal_moves.count() >= 5

motifs.name: stm_central_piece_value_lead
motifs.description: The side to move has at least two more total piece value on the central 4x4 box (files c through f, ranks 3 through 6) than the opponent.

motifs.name: stm_development_edge_advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has strictly fewer undeveloped (back-rank) knights or bishops than the opponent, indicating superior piece development and initiative.

motifs.name: stm_central_pawn_density_pressure_advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has more pawns and pieces on files c through f within its attack zone than the opponent has on the corresponding files, indicating central pressure and space, with a non-pawn attacker of the centre.

motifs.name: stm_dual_check_sources
motifs.description: The side to move has legal checking moves from at least two different pieces, indicating coordinated pressure on the opponent king.

motifs.name: stm_king_pawn_shield_advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has a complete pawn shield in front of its back-rank king while the opponent king lacks such a shield.

motifs.name: stm_royal_fork_check_targets_major_piece
motifs.description: The side to move has a legal checking move that either captures an enemy rook or queen or, after the move, attacks an enemy rook or queen with the moved piece.

motifs.name: stm_nonpawn_king_zone_attack_ratio
motifs.description: The side to move has at least two non-pawn pieces attacking the opponent king's 3x3 zone while the opponent has at most one non-pawn piece attacking the side-to-move king's 3x3 zone.

motifs.name: stm_bishop_pair_advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has the bishop pair while the opponent has at most one bishop.
motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'stm_bishop_pair_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = "The side to move has the bishop pair while the opponent has at most one bishop."

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    b = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = b.turn
    opp = not stm
    return len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP, stm)) >= 2 and len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP, opp)) <= 1

motifs.name: stm_favorable_trade_capture
motifs.description: The side to move has a legal capture of an enemy non-pawn piece that wins at least two points of material in the exchange or is undefended, bringing the static material balance to at least even.

motifs.name: stm_supported_minor_attacks_opp_king_zone
motifs.description: The side to move has a knight or bishop that is defended by a friendly pawn and that attacks a square adjacent to the opponent king, indicating a stable outpost applying pressure near the enemy king.

motifs.name: stm_central_pawn_phalanx_advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has a more advanced pair of friendly pawns on adjacent central files (c-d, d-e, or e-f) than any such opponent pawn phalanx, indicating central tension and space control.

motifs.name: stm_attacks_hanging_opp_king_neighbor
motifs.description: The side to move has at least one legal, non-sacrificial check or capture on a square adjacent to the opponent king.

motifs.name: stm_attacks_opp_strong_piece_asymmetry
motifs.description: The side to move has at least one safe attack by a non-pawn piece on an enemy non-pawn piece while the opponent has no safe non-pawn attack on the side-to-move non-pawn pieces.

motifs.name: stm_central_knight_outpost
motifs.description: The side to move has a knight on a central square (files c-f, ranks 4-5) defended by a friendly pawn and not attackable by any enemy pawn.

motifs.name: stm_rook_uncontested_on_halfopen_file
motifs.description: The side to move has a rook on a file with no friendly pawns where the opponent has no rook or queen on that file.

motifs.name: stm_backward_pawn_advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has no backward pawns while the opponent has at least one backward pawn.

motifs.name: stm_active_major_in_opp_back_two_ranks
motifs.description: The side to move has a rook or queen in the opponent's back two ranks attacking an enemy pawn while the opponent has no rook or queen in the side-to-move's back two ranks attacking side-to-move pawns.
